test_title: PYST 4: SSC JE CE - General Awareness (Held On 10 Oct 2023 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question: To provide opportunities for women to become self-reliant and independent by undertaking self-employment opportunities, an initiative has been launched by the MSME Ministry in 2022, under which 20% of seats in free skill development programs organized under the skill development schemes of the Ministry Will be allocated for women. Recognize this initiative.
solution:
The correct answer is the __SAMARTH.__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

SAMARTH Initiative

__
 
• ​On the occasion of International Women’s Day 2022, the Union Minister for Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises launched this initiative.
 
• It will benefit aspiring and existing women entrepreneurs.
 
• 20% of seats in free Skill Development Programs will be allocated to Women.
 
• 20% of MSME business delegations sent to domestic & international exhibitions will be dedicated to women-owned MSMEs.
 
• 20% discount on the annual processing fee on National Small Industries Corporation’s commercial schemes.
 
• Through this initiative, the Ministry of MSME is focusing on providing skill development and market development assistance to women.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] Confusion Points__

 
• Samarth Scheme, also known as Scheme for Capacity Building in the Textile Sector is implemented by the ministry of textiles.
